units: <cite ref="Berakhot 44a:14">Ber. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>על המחיה ועל הכ׳</he> (be blessed &c.) for sustenance and support.

senses.gloss: supply, esp. basket containing chosen fruits designated for use.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 4:10">Eduy. IV, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 4:9">9</cite>); <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:2">Maasr. IV, 2</cite> <he>כַּלְכָּלַת שבת</he> supply of fruits for the Sabbath (not for sale).
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:2">Ib.</cite> <he>הלוקט הכ׳ וכ׳</he> he who selects figs to send as a present. Y. ib. IV, 51ᵇ <he>כ׳ שבת אינה וכ׳</he> Sabbath supply must not be sold.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 2:2:4">Y. Ter. II, end, 41ᵈ</cite> <he>תאינים שבכ׳</he> figs in the provision basket, opp. <cite ref="M00596"><he>מוּקְצֶה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:1:10">Y. Dem. I, 21ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כ׳ אחת וכ׳</he> there is only one basketful (of the late fruits) which I reserve &c.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33:1">Lev. R. s. 33</cite>, beg. <he>כ׳ של תאנים</he> a basket of figs for use (subject to tithes even for luncheon, v. <cite ref="I00066"><he>טֶבֶל</he></cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>כַּלְכָּלוֹת</he>.
